messages.subject: Ne2-1 error
parts:
Hi all,

I have been having the next error when I am trying to run the gl.LDNe functon. Somedoby have an idea about how I can fix it.  I have been chancing the folders but it is not working. 
Thank you so much,
Laia



> Ne <- gl.LDNe(
+   gl9,
+   outfile = "genepopLD.txt",
+   outpath = '.',

+   mating = "random",
+   plot.out = TRUE,
+   plot_theme = theme_dartR(),

messages.author: b3d929c6746ca81a
messages.subject: Re: [dartR] Ne2-1 error
parts:
Hi Laia,

seems like the Ne2-1.exe is not in your working directory.

Did you download it from the website provided at the help pages?
If not download and save it in the folder you link via the neest.path argument.

using your current code you need to see it using

dir(getwd())

Cheers, Bernd
